name: Sylas Clair

backstory.title: Intro
paragraphs: Looking tonight’s guests up and down, Jean Wesley, reporter and interviewer, fixed her sleeves and collar, putting on her best smile, right as the count hit zero. The small red light flickered to life. Introduction. Advertisement. Greetings. And Showtime. Sylas Clair, front-man of the famous punk-rock-band State of Mind fixed her with indefinably colored eyes and a charming smile, monochrome hair falling over his shoulders in long waves. He did not seem to mind the spotlight, appearing to bask in it instead, laid back comfortably, legs leisurely crossed and that smile never faltering. His older brother appeared equally calm, albeit less pleased to be present, arms crossed and smile slightly plastered around the edges. Their younger sister, Morgan, had declined the invitation, though; personal reasons, apparently. Jean had enough sense to not dig further.

A handful of pleasantries, some easy questions, easier answers. The brothers talked an equal amount, each of them answering the questions they found most intriguing. And then. “Now, you two.” Sylas inclined his head lightly, anticipating. Bram’s eyebrows furrowed slightly. “How did you end up where you are today? What events led you here?” The younger brother smiled again, cat-like, sharp gaze digging into her, before softening. He skipped the parts everybody knew about. All three siblings were born and raised in Spring Valley, Nevada, starting their career as a small band in Las Vegas. “Well, all of this is in big parts thanks to our Ma. She always supported us, believed in us. She suggested us going to Vegas to try and gain a fanbase. I don’t think she expected us to be noticed by Sumerian Records, but that is how things tend to go sometimes.” He could have continued, explaining how their mother had always been there for the three of them, through all the hard times, through their father leaving, through the financial problems. She had been their biggest supporter and their greatest fan.

“We moved to LA a year later and published our first album, “State of Mine”. We also got to know Luther around that time and he agreed to be our bassist. There is not much of a story here to tell, that people don’t know already...”, Bram continued. Sylas nodded slowly. A few more pleasantries were exchanged, questions about the new album were answered and the interview came to a close. As the brothers left the studio, a pleasant silence hung between them. Pleasant but heavy. Heavy with grief, heavy with memories. Both lost in their own thoughts, in their own worlds. Worlds that could not be more different. Although only one of them knew it.

Sylas pondered the interview question. What events had led him here? Too many to count, probably. Meeting Haley Veilstedt was only one such event. Though it was probably the most notable. Without her, he would have never known about the World of Shadows, would have never become part of it. Without her, he would have been dead. He had still died of course. But he was here. Walking under the moon. Not six feet under. He had Haley to thank for that.

backstory.title: Childhood and Career
paragraphs: Born and raised as the middle child of a crumbling marriage in Nevada, Spring Valley, Sylas Brendan Clair grew up with his two-years-older brother, Bram Hendrik Clair and two-years-younger sister Morgan Jean Clair. Their father left when Sylas was 8 years old, leaving the family behind, which, according to their mother and nowadays the kids themselves, was probably for the better. After starting their band “State of Mind” (also referred to as “State of Mine”, seeing as the last letter shows both a d and e combined) the three moved to Las Vegas, being taken under the record label of Sumerian Records. Around this time they were joined by their current bassist Luther Hempton. They steadily grew in popularity, touring the US and later Europe. Moving to LA after their mother’s untimely death, the siblings tend to sometimes perform together, while at other times going solo.

backstory.title: Leading up to, and Embrace
paragraphs: During his early 20s, after a concert, Sylas had an unpleasant run-in with a group of apparent fans, forcing themselves onto him. This left him, to this day, mistrusting people around him, especially his ‘die-hard’-fans. When he was 25, he first met Haley Veilstedt, an, unbeknownst to him, 11th generation Kindred of the Brujah clan. The two became fast friends. Due to her falling into a frenzy around a year after the two met, Sylas discovered her true nature and first got insights into the World of Darkness, refusing to believe her initial attempts at deception. Having a human view on many of the political and systematical intricacies of Kindred society proved surprisingly effective and helpful. Early into 2022, while out celebrating after a concert, Haley and Sylas got into a fight with a group of drunken older men on their way to the hotel. This ended with the singer getting shot and Haley making the split-second decision of embracing him, rather than risking his life and calling an ambulance.

backstory.title: After Embrace
paragraphs: Sylas, thanks to his already existing understanding of Kindred society and closeness with his sire had a relatively positive start to his new existence. Being quite vocal about his opinions and views, he gained both popularity and disdain within both Camarilla and Anarch circles. Haley’s affiliation with the Anarchs meant he had an easier time taking their side, more often than not. Over time though, even getting the chance to meet Annabelle, a local Brujah Anarch with similarly ambitious goals to him, he became unaligned, stating how both sects had positive and negative sides and would be better off collaborating than rivaling with one another. He gained a small following within Brujah circles, oftentimes meeting with Haley, still being good friends, despite the slightly changed nature of their dynamic. A few months ago, Morgan, his younger sister, has been diagnosed with Leukemia, now undergoing medical therapy. He is currently considering whether it would be right to reveal Kindred society to her and with it the prospect of a fail-safe way for her to ‘survive’ the disease. A few days ago, Haley suggested he should go to New York, mainly to try and pry what the current situation is. Which led to the usual small scale deal with a certain ‘Baron of the Bronx’.

npcs.description: His younger sister, still a Mortal.
